text: This report recommends a one-year agreement with Green Savoree Toronto ULC (“GST”) for the 2025 Honda Indy race. The terms and conditions also protect the Board’s right with respect to redevelopment of the Exhibition Place site.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the one-year licence agreement with Green Savoree Toronto ("GST") for the 2025 race with the terms and conditions of the standard license agreement for Exhibition Place as set out in Appendix A to the report (August 30, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, the financial terms set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 30, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, and such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and the City Solicitor. 2.
